result.reason: The clause adds the required annual limit, 30 days' prior written notice, business-hours restriction, independent confidentiality-bound auditor, and prohibition on systems access. However, cost shifting is triggered by any “discrepancy” over 5%, rather than specifically an underpayment exceeding 5%, so it does not fully reach the preferred position. In addition, moving the cost paragraph ahead of subsection (b) is unnecessary and leaves it awkwardly detached from the audit provision. The unrelated audit scope and mutual-selection requirement are otherwise preserved.
